item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-30
item.description:
Our community has seen significant progress across multiple projects recently. The `statcheck` and `escicheck` tools have received updates, with `statcheck` focusing on administrative updates and `escicheck` synchronizing with the `escicheckapp` repository to incorporate the latest features from `effectcheck` version `0.6.14`. Meanwhile, `oddpub` has improved its ontogenerator's code validation, and `docpluck` has addressed various issues, including text loss and rendering fixes. Additionally, `coarse` has added new models and deep literature search features, and `regcheck` has resolved several bugs and improved its demo page and survey routes. These connections between projects demonstrate the collaborative spirit of our community, and we celebrate the progress made towards improving open-source research tools.

6 commits across 3 active repositories this week.
